cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only checking the weather. I'll choose what goes in tomorrow's walking reminder: are we taking the ridge or the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ridge. We changed because the river path flooded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put the flood warning first. Where are we meeting? I'll decide which directions people need.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've asked me twice. Have you forgotten your own itinerary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking it works without my help. Give me the briefing you'd give a newcomer, starting with where I report. I'll take the notes for everyone.

reason: Final dialogue edit: trim explanation after taxi introduction, keep dinner service facts consistent, state access to booking confirmation and remove unnecessary evaluator-position claim from hiking briefing.
